provenance.reason: Shading.apply quantizes at a tie point shifted -0.024 of a channel step, absorbing the sub-LSB gap between one multiply here and a fragment's chain on a GPU. Read off vanilla's own output bytes: over 2994216 (texel, output) constraints from a goat, a pillager and an evoker at five shade factors, a zero shift explains 98.47% and the plateau this sits in explains 99.62%. A shade factor cannot absorb it - the gap is constant in output space, so one factor over-brightens a dark texel and leaves a bright one right. Every sweep falls but one: block 129.8391 to 117.9441, entity 20.9361 to 17.7543, entity-animation 3.1497 to 2.2489, player 8.4556 to 8.3792, armor 17.9895 to 17.9822, item 128.9575 to 128.9549, menu unmoved; glint rises 0.0281 across four leather rows already between 84 and 120.
